name: Aggieland Dumpster Rentals
summary: Dump trailers for Bryan and College Station. The company does not state an exact yard size. The FAQ says the trailers average just under 20 yards and sit within a few yards of each other.
accepted: The FAQ says no items are completely prohibited. Extra fees apply if tires, Freon units, or chemicals are disposed of. Those fee amounts are not published.
prohibited: The FAQ says no items are completely prohibited.
gaps: Extra day fee (packages are 1, 2, 3, and 7 days)
Tax dollar amount (homepage prices are plus tax)
